run_pipeline_img2img: run the StableDiffusion3Img2ImgPipeline to generate images from a prompt and input image with configurable strength and guidance scale
encode_prompt_text: encode text prompts using CLIP and T5 text encoders into prompt embeddings with support for negative prompts and clip skip
prepare_latents_image: prepare latent variables by encoding an input image through the VAE and adding noise at a given timestep for image-to-image generation
calculate_shift_timesteps: calculate the dynamic shifting mu value for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length and shift parameters
retrieve_timesteps_scheduler: retrieve timesteps from a diffusion scheduler by calling set_timesteps with configurable num_inference_steps, custom timesteps, or sigmas
